signals.summary: A seasonal wave of recipes built around peak late-summer produce — tomatoes, corn, peaches, cucumbers, stone fruit — pushed by major food publishers as August closes out.
signals.why_now: Many independent outlets carry it right now in season: KRON4 'Summer recipes make the season last longer' (126h), Allrecipes 'Mom-Approved Cucumber Tomato Salad ... for August' (213h), WaPo creamy brie summer meals (381h), Simply Recipes '27 Tomato Recipes I'm Making All Summer' (429h), plus multiple Food & Wine roundups (summer salads with tomatoes/corn, summer fruit with peaches). Clearly seasonal and squarely in-season on Aug 24.

signals.summary: A social-media aesthetic wave around vividly colorful, gradient-toned food and drink — three-colored fruit arrangements and gradient peach-infused lattes — optimized for the camera.
signals.why_now: Two of the freshest items in the pool, both in the last ~12 hours: cna.al '3-Colored Fruit / The New Food Trend That's Taking Over Social Media' (8h) and Trend Hunter 'Top 100 Food Trends in August: From Gradient Peach-Infused Lattes...' (11.2h). Fresh, but thin source diversity (one is an aggregator listicle).

signals.summary: Protein-maxxing continues as a dominant food macro-trend — protein ice cream, high-protein snacks and crunchwraps, and protein-fortified dairy and baked goods.
signals.why_now: Recent independent coverage: NOW Toronto dietitian on the latest protein-packed trend (84.7h) and Michael West Media on a high-protein trend bulking up an Aussie brand (95.7h), atop persistent trade and creator support (Forbes 'Protein Ice Cream Is This Summer's Next Food Trend', Baking Business protein-vs-fiber, Ethan Chlebowski's high-protein crunchwrap). An ongoing evergreen macro-trend rather than a spike.
